notes.title: Windowed Mode Now Available
notes.notes:
The option to play in windowed mode is now available. 

To access the previous build to keep your saves: go to your Steam library -> right click Hoshizora no Memoria -Eternal Heart- HD -> properties -> betas -> select launch branch -> wait for the update and start playing. 

If the option for the launch branch isn't appearing please restart your Steam client. [b]The windowed mode version will not be compatible with your previous saves so please keep this in mind when swapping over. Trying to access previous saves will result in a crash. It is not possible to resize the window when playing either.[/b] This is exactly the same as the original Japanese HD release. Please let us know if you encounter any issues when playing. We hope you enjoy Hoshizora no Memoria -Eternal Heart- HD.
